Package an5.adapters

Class An5Query

java.lang.Object
an5.adapters.An5Query
public class An5Query extends Object
A query built fluently and handed to a table client.

Every field is optional, so new An5Query() means "no filter, no order, no limit" — the same thing the other adapters read from an omitted argument.
